header.title: Evalezy app
header.description: A simple app for checking answer copies: pick an assessment, scan or upload the copies, the AI checks them, download the checked copies as a zip. It opens at evalezy.vacademy.io and in the Evalezy mobile app, with the same login.

enabled.label: Allow Evalezy
enabled.description: Your admins can sign in to Evalezy. When off, Evalezy shows that it is turned off for your institute.

camera.label: Scan with camera
camera.description: Copies can be scanned page by page with the phone or laptop camera.

upload.label: Upload files
upload.description: Copies can be uploaded as PDFs or photos from the device.

notifyEmail.label: Email when checked
notifyEmail.description: The person who sent the copies gets an email when the batch is checked.

quality.label: Scan quality
quality.description: Higher quality reads small or faint handwriting better, but uploads take longer.
